text: Materials Science and Engineering is one of the key engineering majors of Wenzhou University, and materials science is a key discipline in Zhejiang Province, a top priority discipline of Wenzhou University, and a key discipline of Wenzhou University's "Discipline Enhancement Strategy" construction project. In 1998, Wenzhou University opened the main courses of materials science and engineering, polymer chemistry and other materials. In 2002, he began to enroll undergraduate majors in materials science and engineering. In 2014, in response to the development needs of materials discipline, the Department of Materials Science and Engineering was established, which is affiliated to the School of Chemistry and Materials Engineering. The Department of Materials Science and Engineering is oriented to meet the needs of the material industry in the fields of socialist modernization and scientific and technological development, combined with the development needs of the new materials industry, and strives to cultivate a strong sense of innovation and social responsibility, good humanistic qualities and healthy psychological quality, and can engage in the research and development, design, production and management of new materials and products in the fields of plastics, rubber, fiber, synthetic leather, semiconductor materials, functional ceramic materials, new energy materials, biological and medical materials, environmental materials, etc. Application-oriented and composite senior engineering technology and engineering management talents with strong engineering practice ability.
